thread:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT (P1) — Smart routing policy engine exceptions detected in prod. Large number of requests are hitting fallback variants in a loop; latency and 5xx spike. Paging on-call.

pagerduty: SCHEDULE ALERT -> Primary on-call: Alex W (prod)

Alex W: I’m on it. Can someone paste the failing logs / stack?

Maria C: seeing a lot of `policy_engine.evaluate` exceptions in the logs, looks like an expression compiler error after yesterday's policy push. High QPS in US and EU.

Sanjeev R: Copy. Observing repeated re-routes from us-west -> eu-west -> us-west for the same request id, looks like routing fallbacks keep flipping region. Could be a bad rule that returns incompatible model variants.

Katie: Customer impact: 12 paying customers showing increased latency, 3 enterprise customers hitting >10s median and some timeouts. No data exfil. Big P99 token latency.

Alex W: Temporary mitigation idea: disable smart-routing policy group for global routes so requests go to default model pool. Anyone can flip that via routing-admin? Don’t want a full rollback if we can toggle feature flag.

Thomas L: I can do the toggle. Which flag exactly? name in console? 

Maria C: It's `routing.smart_policy.enabled: true` scoped to `global-routes`. Set to `false` to force default routing. Runbook step: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/configs/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"global-routes","smart_policy.enabled":false}'
```

Sanjeev R: Past incidents: policy-engine exceptions came from malformed condition expressions after a policy author edited a YAML block. Trace from logs:
```
2026-06-05T14:12:34Z ERROR policy-engine: failed to compile rule id=pol-8234 expr="region in [\"us\", \"eu\"] && model.size == large" err="invalid expression: comparison between string and identifier"
stack: runtime error: invalid type assertion at policy/compiler.go:214
```

Alex W: That matches. Looks like the expression parser interprets `large` as identifier rather than string literal. That would cause evaluation to throw and policy runtime to return error, triggering fallback.

incident-bot: NOTE -> Multiple automated fallbacks detected. System is cycling requests to alternate variants, but policy evaluation resets routing context on error which is creating a loop. Recommending immediate flag flip.

Thomas L: I toggled the flag to false at 14:15Z. Rolling requests to default pool now. Monitoring.

Maria C: After the toggle, error rate on policy evaluation dropped ~95% within 30s, latency p95 improved. Still seeing some in-flight loops draining.

Sanjeev R: Can we also blacklist the broken policy id pol-8234 to avoid it being evaluated again while we patch? There’s an API for disabling a single policy.

Alex W: Yes. Running disable:
```
POST /admin/policies/disable
{ "policy_id": "pol-8234", "reason": "runtime exception causing fallback loop" }
```

Katie: Noted for customer comms: CS alerted enterprise customers and offered temporary mitigation + postmortem. No data loss. SLA hit potential for two customers — ops to follow up.

Thomas L: Handoff: I need to sign off in 20m. Alex, can you take primary until Sanjeev rotates in? @Sanjeev R please confirm ETA.

Sanjeev R: ETA ~25m, will take over. I’ll start a deeper root cause. Suspect policy authoring UI allowed unquoted tokens in expression language. We should hard-fail edits in the UI or sanitize.

Alex W: Agree. Action items: 1) Patch policy compiler to give clearer edit-time validation (owner: Sanjeev). 2) Add CI guard on policy YAMLs (owner: Maria). 3) Improve monitoring to detect evaluation exceptions faster (owner: Thomas). 4) Customer follow-up (owner: Katie).

Maria C: Creating an incident channel and tracking tasks in the runbook. Will add links here. Also saving offending policy version and author for roll-forward/rollback.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigation applied (smart routing disabled), impact reduced but not fully resolved until policy is patched. Severity: P1 -> keeping open. Incident lead: Alex W.

Alex W: Leaving handoff notes: nothing critical pending besides root-cause fix and policy validation, continue to watch consumer SLOs. Posting logs & dev reproduction in #eng-runtime after this thread.

Sanjeev R: Reproducer: small policy snippet that fails:
```
- id: pol-8234
  when: "region in [\"us\", \"eu\"] && model.size == large"
  then: route: eu-optimized
```
Fix is to quote `large` or use size=="large". Will prepare a patch to the compiler to reject unquoted identifiers.

Katie: I'll draft the customer-facing note for CS: quick summary, mitigation, ETA for permanent fix (TBD), and apologetic tone. Will circulate for review.

incident-bot: Closing note: keep this thread for timeline. Postmortem to follow within 72h. Reactions: :white_check_mark: to mitigations, :eyes: for monitoring checks.

Maria C: updating runbook with CLI commands used and toggles. Will attach timeline + metrics.

Sanjeev R: Taking ownership of the CR for the compiler fix, target patch in next deploy window. Will also add lint rule for policy commits.

Alex W: Thanks everyone. Monitoring shows p99 latency back within SLO for most customers. Will keep incident open until compiler fix lands and policies re-enabled.
